sheets.title: FLOOR PLANS — DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting and power floor plan demolition. Two plans side-by-side at 1/8"=1'-0". Building is single-story industrial footprint. Demolition scope: remove most existing lighting fixtures (including high bay LED fixtures), water heater circuit, exhaust fans, AHU, heat pump circuits. Retain: existing Cutler-Hammer 600V 400A 3P safety switch (building electrical service), existing MDP, existing 75 KVA Cutler-Hammer transformer, existing Square D 200A/3P disconnect, existing panels A, B, C, office panel '1', existing Eaton 75 KVA transformer, existing air compressor, existing AHUs, some existing high bay LED fixtures. Remove CCTV camera. Remove combination emergency/exit fixture. Note: existing telecom managed by Verizon; security by Johnson Controls.

sheets.title: FLOOR PLANS — NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Lighting and power floor plan new work. Key new work: new LED high bay fixtures at industrial work area; new LED recessed/surface fixtures in office and restroom areas; new occupancy sensors; new AHU-1 (38A, 208V, 1PH); new HP-1 (26.3A, 208V, 1PH); new EF-1 and EF-2. New Panel D (emergency, 100A, 208Y/120V, 3-phase). New 25 kVA UPS, 208Y/120V, 3PH. New 20 kW/25 kVA generator with ATS. SINTER-2 oven in Panel C loads. RFI #9 circuit noted.
